name: Yukine Kurisu
source:
Chris Yukine is a character appearing in Higurashi no Naku Koro ni Mei in the Senki Zesshō Symphogear XD Unlimited collaboration event Warrior Princess March. She is a Symphogear wearer sent alongside Hibiki Tachibana and Miku Kohinata to track down a missing artifact in the Higurashi world.

[From 07th Expansion Wikia]
